title: Amount of Support Provided to Seniors in Past Five Years
what_it_is: Amount of Support Provided to Seniors in Past Five Years

sections.label: Government support for seniors
sections.summary: The Government has provided seniors healthcare, social support and housing transfers, and introduced cost-of-living measures including cash payouts and GST vouchers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Mohd Fahmi Aliman
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Social and Family Development (a) in the past five years, what is the total amount of support, including financial assistance, healthcare programmes and social support initiatives, that the Government has provided to our seniors; (b) whether there are any plans in place to further assist seniors in coping with the rising cost of living; and (c) if so, what are the details of these initiatives.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: This covered relevant healthcare, social support and housing-related Government transfers that households with seniors benefited from, such as the GST Voucher scheme, Assurance Package, Government top-ups to CPF, Pioneer and Merdeka Generation Packages, ComCare assistance and Silver Support.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: The Government has introduced measures to help Singaporeans cope with cost-of-living concerns, such as the enhancements to the Assurance Package.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Eligible seniors received up to $700 cash support in June 2023 from the Cost-of-Living Special Payment and Cost-of-Living Seniors' Bonus.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Upcoming support includes the GSTV-Cash payments of up to $700, GSTV-MediSave top-ups of up to $450 in August 2023 and Assurance Package Cash payouts of up to $600 in December 2023.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M)
sentences.text: Beyond cash support and subsidies, the Government will continue to work together with our community partners, such as the Silver Generation Office, to jointly engage and extend support to our seniors as needed.

sections.label: Cost-of-living support publicity channels
sections.summary: Recent cost-of-living support was published in newspapers, radio capsules and summary graphics on digital display panels in HDB estates and condominiums.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: For example, the most recent cost-of-living support has been printed in newspapers, like The Straits Times, Lianhe Zaobao and on radio capsules, and we have also put them in summary graphics in digital display panels across the Housing and Development Board (HDB) estates and condominium developments.

sections.label: Silver Generation Ambassadors as contacts
sections.summary: Silver Generation Ambassadors under AIC are key contact points who know seniors and available support, and the public can contact them for help.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: Most importantly, I think we know the Silver Generation Ambassadors who are under Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) are the main key contact points.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: These are not only those who have built relationships with our seniors and their caregivers, but they also know the kind of support available for them that can be suited to these seniors.

sentences.speaker: Mr Masagos Zulkifli B M M
sentences.text: I hope that if in doubt and when we know our neighbours, perhaps, need some form of help and do not know where to get this help, particularly, if they are seniors, please contact AIC, Silver Generation Office Ambassadors.
